name: python-json-patch
title: JSON Patch
blurb: JSON Pointer and JSON Patch, implemented against the RFCs rather than against the happy path. Pointers are parsed with their two escapes, so a key that contains a slash or a tilde stays one key; a segment that looks like a number is an object key when the target is an object; add inserts and remove shifts, while '-' only ever means the end of a list. Patches are applied to a copy and thrown away if any operation fails, so a refused patch leaves nothing behind — the demo shows a failing test operation rolling back two adds, and a computed diff being applied and compared against the document it was taken from.
default_description: JSON Pointer and JSON Patch that refuse to guess, with a diff that proves itself by applying.
